scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older woman in a cream veil gestures as she speaks to a crowned man in a purple cloak, who listens beside her in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts King Lemuel listening to his mother's instruction, reflecting the verse's introduction to his words.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A head-covered woman sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, holding a knotted cord and gesturing toward a bearded man seated opposite her. He leans in attentively; clay jars, greenery, and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse's repeated appeal to a son of the speaker's womb and vows. The knotted cord is an invented visual reminder of her vows.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king raises one hand as he turns away from two women beside a richly draped pavilion, one holding a cup; a cracked crown rests on a stone ledge, and a sunlit city lies ahead.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative interpretation of the warning shows a king declining an invitation; the cracked crown suggests the ruin of kings that can follow giving away one's strength or pursuing destructive ways.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned king in purple robes sits in a sunlit palace courtyard and raises his hand toward an attendant offering a tray with a cup of red wine and a clay jug.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Lemuel declining wine, illustrating Proverbs 31:4's warning that wine and intoxicating drink are not for kings and princes.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone court, a crowned ruler holds a golden goblet and looks away while a man and woman in worn clothes wait before him. A blank rolled scroll and an uneven balance scale sit on a table, with guards and a hillside city behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the ruler's cup, neglected scroll, uneven scales and waiting petitioners to picture the warning that drinking may lead to forgetting the law and denying justice to the afflicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone room, a man helps a frail older man in bed hold a clay cup while a woman offers a cup of red wine to a sorrowful seated woman. Jugs and grapes rest on a table nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures drinks being offered in comfort to a frail person and a grieving person, reflecting the verse's strong drink for one who is perishing and wine for those bitter of heart.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in worn robes sits by a stone doorway, eyes closed, sipping from a clay cup. Work tools and a basket holding a little food are nearby, with a sunlit village and dry hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The man's quiet moment as he drinks imagines the verse's forgetting of poverty and misery; his worn clothing and scant food suggest his hardship.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a man speaks with an outstretched hand to a seated elder beside a set of balance scales. A woman, a child, and an older man stand near the speaker while guards and other onlookers watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined town-gate hearing illustrates the call to speak for the mute and plead the cause of those whose lives are at stake; the verse does not describe this particular event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone town gate, a seated elder speaks and extends his hand toward a man and woman in patched clothing while other elders listen. Balanced scales rest on the table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined town-gate hearing portrays speaking and judging fairly on behalf of poor and needy people, as called for in Proverbs 31:9.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman hands a loaf of bread to an elderly woman while a man watches. Red gemstones spill from an open pouch on a wooden table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative act of generosity pictures a virtuous wife whose worth the verse places far above rubies. The people and event are not specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a small pouch smiles at a woman sorting grain in a woven basket, with baskets of figs and olives in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene suggests the husband's trust in his wife; the full baskets picture the gain he does not lack.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman offers a round loaf to a smiling man beside an olive tree, a table of bread, and clay jars.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined offering of bread portrays her doing him good; the mature olive tree and well-worn path suggest kindness continuing throughout her life.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman in a sunlit stone courtyard draws wool into thread with a wooden spindle. A basket of fluffy wool and a separate bundle of flax stalks, blue flowers and pale fibers sit beside her.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the woman seeking wool and flax and working willingly with her hands; the courtyard and spindle are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman carries a basket of bread, fruit, and a pitcher along a rocky path toward a stone house, with sailing ships and people handling goods at a harbor behind her.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a woman carrying food from a harbor evokes the verse's comparison of her to merchant ships bringing food from afar.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a lamplit stone home, a woman gives a bowl of bread and food to another woman, while a third holds a portion beside a table of loaves and fruit; stars shine through the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative interpretation of Proverbs 31:15: a woman provides food for her household and portions for her maidservants while it is still night.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman carrying folded woven cloth holds out silver pieces to a standing man, while another man kneels to plant a grapevine in a sunlit field.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative interpretation shows a woman considering and buying a field and a vineyard planted from the earnings of her work. The male planter reflects the supplied 'he plants' gloss; the cloth and exchange are imagined details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman with rolled sleeves pulls a red woven sash around her waist in a sunlit stone courtyard. Baskets and clay jars sit nearby, with hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the verse's image of a woman girding her waist with strength and strengthening her arms. The courtyard and its details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a headscarf smiles as she examines a red woven cloth at a table stacked with textiles. A clay oil lamp burns beside her, and stars shine over a village through the open window.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 31:18: the woman recognizes that her merchandise is good while her lamp burns at night. The textiles and workshop are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, drawing wool from a distaff with one hand and holding a spindle with the other. A strand of yarn stretches between them, with baskets and clay vessels nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 31:19, showing her reaching to the distaff and holding the spindle while she spins.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman extends a round loaf toward a seated man in worn, patched clothing, and both reach for it with their hands. Baskets, clay jars, leafy vines, and distant buildings surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the woman extending her hand to the poor and reaching out to the needy in Proverbs 31:20. The bread and courtyard are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Inside a stone home, a woman fastens a scarlet wrap around a child while a man and another child, also dressed in scarlet, sit nearby. Snow falls outside the open door.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined winter household illustrates the verse's assurance that she need not fear snow for her household because all are clothed in scarlet.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in an ivory garment and purple mantle sits at a loom weaving a patterned purple and gold covering. Another woven covering lies on a bed in the sunlit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the woman making coverings for herself and wearing fine linen and purple in Proverbs 31:22. The loom and setting are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits with older men at a sunlit stone town gateway while a passing man greets them; buildings and hills appear beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the husband known at the gates, seated among the elders of the land; a passerby's greeting suggests his recognition.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman offers a patterned sash to a merchant holding coins beside a wooden loom and a table of folded linen; a loaded camel stands behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows a craftswoman supplying a sash to a merchant, with a loom and folded linen suggesting the linen garments she makes and sells in Proverbs 31:24.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling woman in a cream dress and a richly patterned red cloak stands on a stone terrace, looking toward a sunlit valley, distant village, and winding path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the woman's woven cloak and joyful gaze toward the horizon to picture strength and honor as her clothing and her rejoicing in the time to come.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman gestures as she speaks to an attentive younger listener beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard with clay jars.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates the verse's wisdom and teaching of kindness; the setting and listener are imaginative.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman kneads dough beside a loaf of bread and looks toward a child folding a woven blanket. Another person carries a large clay jar, while a man works at a wooden bench behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows the woman attending to her household while working at bread dough, echoing the verse's picture of watching over her home and not eating the bread of idleness.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated woman smiles up at a gesturing man while three children gather around her in a sunlit stone courtyard, framed by flowering vines, earthenware jars and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative family gathering reflects Proverbs 31:28, where her children rise and call her blessed and her husband praises her. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman places a flower wreath on another woman's head while four smiling women look on with woven cloth, bread, and fruit.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined moment of praise uses the wreath to single out one woman, reflecting the verse's praise of her as excelling among many women who have done well.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman in a green dress and white head covering bows her head with her hands clasped while two smiling women gesture toward her. A wilted flower and a bronze hand mirror rest on a stone ledge.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the fading flower and mirror to suggest passing outward beauty, while the woman's reverent posture and her neighbors' praise reflect the verse's honor for a woman who fears Yahweh.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone gateway, a woman presents a basket of grapes, pomegranates and figs to another woman as townspeople smile and gesture; woven cloth and a clay jar rest nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts a woman honored at the city gate, with produce and woven work representing the fruit of her hands and her deeds in Proverbs 31:31.
